semgrep-juice-shop.note: Identity = semgrep rule id (compared only within its namespace) + file + location, with agreeing CWE; no source fingerprints exist. 40 exact matches. Drift: per rule+file, findings not claimed exactly were aligned in line order to unmatched candidates; identical span shape, or for a lone pair identical span width, => matched (ci.yml +1, fileServer/redirect -1, userProfile eval + code-string-concat 61->65 same width/indent +2, server.ts directory-listing x4 +19 by identical column spans). server.ts:268 (cols 3-163) has no counterpart => new. 17 terraform-rule hits in files with no finding of that rule, and path-join-resolve-traversal in lib/antiCheat.ts => new, one group each. Bearer findings at the same spots are a different weakness, not targets.

bearer-juice-shop.note: Identity = bearer rule id + file + location, CWE agreeing; no fingerprints. 240 exact. 151 drift matches by order-preserving alignment per rule+file on identical span shape: frontend components +1, userProfile +3/+4 (eval same width, indent +2), lib/utils -6, antiCheat +12, server.ts +19..+21 (logger 689->709 paired as the lone equal-width leftover in its gap). checkov-terragoat.note: Identity = checkov check id + file + symbol (resource address) + block location. 357 exact. 106 drift: each unmatched check pairs 1:1 with the orphan finding for the same check, file and symbol whose block moved 1-2 lines or grew/shrank by a line (db-app, ecr, es, rds, s3, eks, lambda .tf). The resource symbol anchors identity across the resize, so matched. CKV_AWS_20 on aws_s3_bucket.data is not re-observed (ACL gone, block shrank). CKV_OCI_7/8/9/10 on oci_objectstorage_bucket.secretsquirrel have no finding of that check on that resource => new, one group each. Findings from kics/trivy on the same resources are other namespaces, never targets.

kics-terragoat.note: Identity = KICS query id + file + symbol + startLine, CWE agreeing. 253 exact, incl. kics-227/228: two records with one identity, both matched to ...1135 (which already holds two observations). 47 drift: each unmatched query pairs with the orphan of the same query/file/symbol after a uniform file shift (+1 in db-app/rds/eks/lambda/es, -1/-2 in s3.tf), including symbol-less secret checks in lambda.tf and the two eks.tf 'n/a' hits aligned in order (142->143, 146->147). The S3 ACL finding is not re-observed. 'Name Is Not Snake Case' (oracle/compartment.tf) and 'Variable Without Type' (oracle/variables.tf) have no counterpart => new.

trivy-terragoat.note: Identity = trivy check id + file + symbol + block location. 184 exact, incl. trivy-227/228 (two records, one identity) -> ...1431. 70 drift matches: same check, file and resource symbol with the block moved 1-2 lines or resized by a line. trivy-37..41 are five identical AWS-0038 records for aws_eks_cluster.eks_cluster (117-140 -> 118-141); all match ...1244, which already had five observations. Dockerfile checks have no location and match on check id + file. AWS-0092 on aws_s3_bucket.data is not re-observed. No new or unresolved candidates.

trivy-juice-shop-image.note: Identity = vulnerability ids (trivy id = CVE/GHSA, with matching cve/ghsa) + package ecosystem, name and installationPath. Package version is observation snapshot context that findings do not store, so an upgrade that still carries the same CVE matches (13 such, e.g. brace-expansion 1.1.15->1.1.18, ip-address 10.2.0->10.5.0). 160 exact matches. 15 CVEs on undici 5.29.0 and @fastify/busboy 2.1.1 have no finding on that package/path => new, one group per CVE. 16 findings for CVEs fixed by upgrades are not re-observed. Copies of a package at different installation paths are separate findings.
